SELECT sc.id, sc.student_no, sc.course_id, sc.score, sc.learn_status, s.real_name AS studentName, s.college, s.major, c.course_name AS courseName FROM biz_student_course sc LEFT JOIN biz_student_profile s ON sc.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN biz_course c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id
AND sc.course_id = #{courseId} AND sc.learn_status = #{learnStatus}
